semantic_claims.claim: After a complete frame and the deterministic selection, and before the first admission, the exact ordered winners, the not-selected set, the quota basis (round quota, day/rolling/active use, committed-in-round, blocked candidates) and the frame identity are durable in the existing round owner row as a self-hashed recovery plan

A restart inside the slack follows the durable plan and never recomputes the selection; a resumed round that still cannot commit a planned winner is recorded with a reason and terminalized as a partial admission, like the after-slack case

After round_start+slack every tick reconciles each STARTED round from durable evidence only with zero provider calls and zero new admissions: none committed or no plan is an honest no-admission gap; all planned committed closes the exact round; a strict subset is a partial admission that keeps the committed admissions; missing/corrupt/conflicting plan, frame, call evidence or admission is a typed refusal without healing

Cohort maturity refuses a relevant round that is STARTED, partial, recovery-refused, has an unreadable frame, or is referenced by an admission without an owner row; an ordinary CLOSED round and a zero-admission honest gap do not block

The store refuses an admission whose round is terminal, plan-less or does not name the episode, and refuses to replace or drop a written plan; rounds without an owner row (direct store use) are not gated

T0 is still the admission commit clock; quota, rolling-24h, active-cap, accounting, protection, stop-intake, population and the 139-point grid are unchanged; a normal non-crash round that drops a planned winner still closes CLOSED with the drop now recorded
